interpretation.ltech: Candidate fails the existing runtime GATT readiness control. Firmware is identical and uninstrumented in both runs.
interpretation.control_limitation: Existing runtime is not a build of the unmodified old GitHub branch. Its boot log explicitly shows HOSTMAILBOX doorbell deadlock acknowledgement; the local compensation is outside the rebased six commits.
interpretation.causality_limit: Missing local compensation explains the observed stalled handshake; importing it and retesting was not performed, so it is not established as the only blocker. No claim that upstream 26q3 introduced this behavior.
interpretation.lg: If both runtimes time out this is an inconclusive negative control, not evidence of a new regression.
interpretation.fidelity_limit: Board mapping is inherited from the corpus and not independently confirmed; synthetic ACKs and model-side compensation do not prove hardware timing fidelity.
